verses.name: رومية 8:1
verses.text: إِذًا لَا شَيْءَ مِنَ ٱلدَّيْنُونَةِ ٱلْآنَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي ٱلْمَسِيحِ يَسُوعَ، ٱلسَّالِكِينَ لَيْسَ حَسَبَ ٱلْجَسَدِ بَلْ حَسَبَ ٱلرُّوحِ.

verses.name: رومية 8:2
verses.text: لِأَنَّ نَامُوسَ رُوحِ ٱلْحَيَاةِ فِي ٱلْمَسِيحِ يَسُوعَ قَدْ أَعْتَقَنِي مِنْ نَامُوسِ ٱلْخَطِيَّةِ وَٱلْمَوْتِ.

verses.name: رومية 8:3
verses.text: لِأَنَّهُ مَا كَانَ ٱلنَّامُوسُ عَاجِزًا عَنْهُ، فِي مَا كَانَ ضَعِيفًا بِٱلْجَسَدِ، فَٱللهُ إِذْ أَرْسَلَ ٱبْنَهُ فِي شِبْهِ جَسَدِ ٱلْخَطِيَّةِ، وَلِأَجْلِ ٱلْخَطِيَّةِ، دَانَ ٱلْخَطِيَّةَ فِي ٱلْجَسَدِ،

verses.name: رومية 8:4
verses.text: لِكَيْ يَتِمَّ حُكْمُ ٱلنَّامُوسِ فِينَا، نَحْنُ ٱلسَّالِكِينَ لَيْسَ حَسَبَ ٱلْجَسَدِ بَلْ حَسَبَ ٱلرُّوحِ.

verses.name: رومية 8:5
verses.text: فَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ حَسَبَ ٱلْجَسَدِ فَبِمَا لِلْجَسَدِ يَهْتَمُّونَ، وَلَكِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ حَسَبَ ٱلرُّوحِ فَبِمَا لِلرُّوحِ.

verses.name: رومية 8:6
verses.text: لِأَنَّ ٱهْتِمَامَ ٱلْجَسَدِ هُوَ مَوْتٌ، وَلَكِنَّ ٱهْتِمَامَ ٱلرُّوحِ هُوَ حَيَاةٌ وَسَلَامٌ.

verses.name: رومية 8:7
verses.text: لِأَنَّ ٱهْتِمَامَ ٱلْجَسَدِ هُوَ عَدَاوَةٌ لِلهِ، إِذْ لَيْسَ هُوَ خَاضِعًا لِنَامُوسِ ٱللهِ، لِأَنَّهُ أَيْضًا لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ.

verses.name: رومية 8:8
verses.text: فَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي ٱلْجَسَدِ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ أَنْ يُرْضُوا ٱللهَ.

verses.name: رومية 8:9
verses.text: وَأَمَّا أَنْتُمْ فَلَسْتُمْ فِي ٱلْجَسَدِ بَلْ فِي ٱلرُّوحِ، إِنْ كَانَ رُوحُ ٱللهِ سَاكِنًا فِيكُمْ. وَلَكِنْ إِنْ كَانَ أَحَدٌ لَيْسَ لَهُ رُوحُ ٱلْمَسِيحِ، فَذَلِكَ لَيْسَ لَهُ.

verses.name: رومية 8:10
verses.text: وَإِنْ كَانَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ فِيكُمْ، فَٱلْجَسَدُ مَيِّتٌ بِسَبَبِ ٱلْخَطِيَّةِ، وَأَمَّا ٱلرُّوحُ فَحَيَاةٌ بِسَبَبِ ٱلْبِرِّ.

verses.name: رومية 8:11
verses.text: وَإِنْ كَانَ رُوحُ ٱلَّذِي أَقَامَ يَسُوعَ مِنَ ٱلْأَمْوَاتِ سَاكِنًا فِيكُمْ، فَٱلَّذِي أَقَامَ ٱلْمَسِيحَ مِنَ ٱلْأَمْوَاتِ سَيُحْيِي أَجْسَادَكُمُ ٱلْمَائِتَةَ أَيْضًا بِرُوحِهِ ٱلسَّاكِنِ فِيكُمْ.

verses.name: رومية 8:12
verses.text: فَإِذًا أَيُّهَا ٱلْإِخْوَةُ نَحْنُ مَدْيُونُونَ لَيْسَ لِلْجَسَدِ لِنَعِيشَ حَسَبَ ٱلْجَسَدِ.

verses.name: رومية 8:13
verses.text: لِأَنَّهُ إِنْ عِشْتُمْ حَسَبَ ٱلْجَسَدِ فَسَتَمُوتُونَ، وَلَكِنْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ بِٱلرُّوحِ تُمِيتُونَ أَعْمَالَ ٱلْجَسَدِ فَسَتَحْيَوْنَ.

verses.name: رومية 8:14
verses.text: لِأَنَّ كُلَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَنْقَادُونَ بِرُوحِ ٱللهِ، فَأُولَئِكَ هُمْ أَبْنَاءُ ٱللهِ.

verses.name: رومية 8:15
verses.text: إِذْ لَمْ تَأْخُذُوا رُوحَ ٱلْعُبُودِيَّةِ أَيْضًا لِلْخَوْفِ، بَلْ أَخَذْتُمْ رُوحَ ٱلتَّبَنِّي ٱلَّذِي بِهِ نَصْرُخُ: «يَا أَبَا ٱلْآبُ».

verses.name: رومية 8:16
verses.text: اَلرُّوحُ نَفْسُهُ أَيْضًا يَشْهَدُ لِأَرْوَاحِنَا أَنَّنَا أَوْلَادُ ٱللهِ.

verses.name: رومية 8:17
verses.text: فَإِنْ كُنَّا أَوْلَادًا فَإِنَّنَا وَرَثَةٌ أَيْضًا، وَرَثَةُ ٱللهِ وَوَارِثُونَ مَعَ ٱلْمَسِيحِ. إِنْ كُنَّا نَتَأَلَّمُ مَعَهُ لِكَيْ نَتَمَجَّدَ أَيْضًا مَعَهُ.

verses.name: رومية 8:18
verses.text: فَإِنِّي أَحْسِبُ أَنَّ آلَامَ ٱلزَّمَانِ ٱلْحَاضِرِ لَا تُقَاسُ بِٱلْمَجْدِ ٱلْعَتِيدِ أَنْ يُسْتَعْلَنَ فِينَا.

verses.name: رومية 8:19
verses.text: لِأَنَّ ٱنْتِظَارَ ٱلْخَلِيقَةِ يَتَوَقَّعُ ٱسْتِعْلَانَ أَبْنَاءِ ٱللهِ.

verses.name: رومية 8:20
verses.text: إِذْ أُخْضِعَتِ ٱلْخَلِيقَةُ لِلْبُطْلِ - لَيْسَ طَوْعًا، بَلْ مِنْ أَجْلِ ٱلَّذِي أَخْضَعَهَا - عَلَى ٱلرَّجَاءِ،

verses.name: رومية 8:21
verses.text: لِأَنَّ ٱلْخَلِيقَةَ نَفْسَهَا أَيْضًا سَتُعْتَقُ مِنْ عُبُودِيَّةِ ٱلْفَسَادِ إِلَى حُرِّيَّةِ مَجْدِ أَوْلَادِ ٱللهِ.

verses.name: رومية 8:22
verses.text: فَإِنَّنَا نَعْلَمُ أَنَّ كُلَّ ٱلْخَلِيقَةِ تَئِنُّ وَتَتَمَخَّضُ مَعًا إِلَى ٱلْآنَ.

verses.name: رومية 8:23
verses.text: وَلَيْسَ هَكَذَا فَقَطْ، بَلْ نَحْنُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَنَا بَاكُورَةُ ٱلرُّوحِ، نَحْنُ أَنْفُسُنَا أَيْضًا نَئِنُّ فِي أَنْفُسِنَا، مُتَوَقِّعِينَ ٱلتَّبَنِّيَ فِدَاءَ أَجْسَادِنَا.

verses.name: رومية 8:24
verses.text: لِأَنَّنَا بِٱلرَّجَاءِ خَلَصْنَا. وَلَكِنَّ ٱلرَّجَاءَ ٱلْمَنْظُورَ لَيْسَ رَجَاءً، لِأَنَّ مَا يَنْظُرُهُ أَحَدٌ كَيْفَ يَرْجُوهُ أَيْضًا؟

verses.name: رومية 8:25
verses.text: وَلَكِنْ إِنْ كُنَّا نَرْجُو مَا لَسْنَا نَنْظُرُهُ فَإِنَّنَا نَتَوَقَّعُهُ بِٱلصَّبْرِ.

verses.name: رومية 8:26
verses.text: وَكَذَلِكَ ٱلرُّوحُ أَيْضًا يُعِينُ ضَعَفَاتِنَا، لِأَنَّنَا لَسْنَا نَعْلَمُ مَا نُصَلِّي لِأَجْلِهِ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي. وَلَكِنَّ ٱلرُّوحَ نَفْسَهُ يَشْفَعُ فِينَا بِأَنَّاتٍ لَا يُنْطَقُ بِهَا.

verses.name: رومية 8:27
verses.text: وَلَكِنَّ ٱلَّذِي يَفْحَصُ ٱلْقُلُوبَ يَعْلَمُ مَا هُوَ ٱهْتِمَامُ ٱلرُّوحِ، لِأَنَّهُ بِحَسَبِ مَشِيئَةِ ٱللهِ يَشْفَعُ فِي ٱلْقِدِّيسِينَ.

verses.name: رومية 8:28
verses.text: وَنَحْنُ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّ كُلَّ ٱلْأَشْيَاءِ تَعْمَلُ مَعًا لِلْخَيْرِ لِلَّذِينَ يُحِبُّونَ ٱللهَ، ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ مَدْعُوُّونَ حَسَبَ قَصْدِهِ.

verses.name: رومية 8:29
verses.text: لِأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَ فَعَرَفَهُمْ سَبَقَ فَعَيَّنَهُمْ لِيَكُونُوا مُشَابِهِينَ صُورَةَ ٱبْنِهِ، لِيَكُونَ هُوَ بِكْرًا بَيْنَ إِخْوَةٍ كَثِيرِينَ.

verses.name: رومية 8:30
verses.text: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَ فَعَيَّنَهُمْ، فَهَؤُلَاءِ دَعَاهُمْ أَيْضًا. وَٱلَّذِينَ دَعَاهُمْ، فَهَؤُلَاءِ بَرَّرَهُمْ أَيْضًا. وَٱلَّذِينَ بَرَّرَهُمْ، فَهَؤُلَاءِ مَجَّدَهُمْ أَيْضًا.

verses.name: رومية 8:31
verses.text: فَمَاذَا نَقُولُ لِهَذَا؟ إِنْ كَانَ ٱللهُ مَعَنَا، فَمَنْ عَلَيْنَا؟

verses.name: رومية 8:32
verses.text: اَلَّذِي لَمْ يُشْفِقْ عَلَى ٱبْنِهِ، بَلْ بَذَلَهُ لِأَجْلِنَا أَجْمَعِينَ، كَيْفَ لَا يَهَبُنَا أَيْضًا مَعَهُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ؟

verses.name: رومية 8:33
verses.text: مَنْ سَيَشْتَكِي عَلَى مُخْتَارِي ٱللهِ؟ ٱللهُ هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُبَرِّرُ.

verses.name: رومية 8:34
verses.text: مَنْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يَدِينُ؟ اَلْمَسِيحُ هُوَ ٱلَّذِي مَاتَ، بَلْ بِٱلْحَرِيِّ قَامَ أَيْضًا، ٱلَّذِي هُوَ أَيْضًا عَنْ يَمِينِ ٱللهِ، ٱلَّذِي أَيْضًا يَشْفَعُ فِينَا.

verses.name: رومية 8:35
verses.text: مَنْ سَيَفْصِلُنَا عَنْ مَحَبَّةِ ٱلْمَسِيحِ؟ أَشِدَّةٌ أَمْ ضِيْقٌ أَمِ ٱضْطِهَادٌ أَمْ جُوعٌ أَمْ عُرْيٌ أَمْ خَطَرٌ أَمْ سَيْفٌ؟

verses.name: رومية 8:36
verses.text: كَمَا هُوَ مَكْتُوبٌ: «إِنَّنَا مِنْ أَجْلِكَ نُمَاتُ كُلَّ ٱلنَّهَارِ. قَدْ حُسِبْنَا مِثْلَ غَنَمٍ لِلذَّبْحِ».

verses.name: رومية 8:37
verses.text: وَلَكِنَّنَا فِي هَذِهِ جَمِيعِهَا يَعْظُمُ ٱنْتِصَارُنَا بِٱلَّذِي أَحَبَّنَا.

verses.name: رومية 8:38
verses.text: فَإِنِّي مُتَيَقِّنٌ أَنَّهُ لَا مَوْتَ وَلَا حَيَاةَ، وَلَا مَلَائِكَةَ وَلَا رُؤَسَاءَ وَلَا قُوَّاتِ، وَلَا أُمُورَ حَاضِرَةً وَلَا مُسْتَقْبَلَةً،

verses.name: رومية 8:39
verses.text: وَلَا عُلْوَ وَلَا عُمْقَ، وَلَا خَلِيقَةَ أُخْرَى، تَقْدِرُ أَنْ تَفْصِلَنَا عَنْ مَحَبَّةِ ٱللهِ ٱلَّتِي فِي ٱلْمَسِيحِ يَسُوعَ رَبِّنَا.

verses.name: Romans 8:1
verses.text: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

verses.name: Romans 8:2
verses.text: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.

verses.name: Romans 8:3
verses.text: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:

verses.name: Romans 8:4
verses.text: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

verses.name: Romans 8:5
verses.text: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.

verses.name: Romans 8:6
verses.text: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.

verses.name: Romans 8:7
verses.text: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.

verses.name: Romans 8:8
verses.text: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.

verses.name: Romans 8:9
verses.text: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.

verses.name: Romans 8:10
verses.text: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.

verses.name: Romans 8:11
verses.text: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.

verses.name: Romans 8:12
verses.text: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

verses.name: Romans 8:13
verses.text: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.

verses.name: Romans 8:14
verses.text: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.

verses.name: Romans 8:15
verses.text: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.

verses.name: Romans 8:16
verses.text: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:

verses.name: Romans 8:17
verses.text: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.

verses.name: Romans 8:18
verses.text: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

verses.name: Romans 8:19
verses.text: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.

verses.name: Romans 8:20
verses.text: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,

verses.name: Romans 8:21
verses.text: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.

verses.name: Romans 8:22
verses.text: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.

verses.name: Romans 8:23
verses.text: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.

verses.name: Romans 8:24
verses.text: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?

verses.name: Romans 8:25
verses.text: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.

verses.name: Romans 8:26
verses.text: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.

verses.name: Romans 8:27
verses.text: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.

verses.name: Romans 8:28
verses.text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

verses.name: Romans 8:29
verses.text: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.

verses.name: Romans 8:30
verses.text: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.

verses.name: Romans 8:31
verses.text: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?

verses.name: Romans 8:32
verses.text: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?

verses.name: Romans 8:33
verses.text: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God’s elect? It is God that justifieth.

verses.name: Romans 8:34
verses.text: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.

verses.name: Romans 8:35
verses.text: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

verses.name: Romans 8:36
verses.text: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

verses.name: Romans 8:37
verses.text: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.

verses.name: Romans 8:38
verses.text: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,

verses.name: Romans 8:39
verses.text: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
